title: Malaria outbreak in Balaghat, death toll rise to 28+ #balaghat #adiwasi #malaria #madhyapradesh

context_gap.death_toll_discrepancy: The video claims 28+ deaths, which overreports the official government record (8 deaths) by 20, and overreports the local ground truth (25 deaths) by 3.
missing_critical_context: The video fails to report on the missing nutrition rations which has compromised community immunity.
The video omits the consumption of contaminated stream water, a primary driver of the local health crisis alongside the malaria outbreak.
